statistical_methodology.confidence_intervals: Wilson Score Method with z = 1.96 (95% coverage)
statistical_methodology.zero_event_handling: A zero observed count (k=0, n=1000) corresponds to 95% CI [0.00%, 0.38%]. It is NOT interpreted as impossibility.
statistical_methodology.sample_independence: Each campaign was executed under independent deterministic PRNG seeds.
potential_biases: Selection bias toward internal butterfly and predicate hooks rather than exhaustive memory-bus sweeps.
Configuration imbalance: screening campaigns used N=1000 whereas focused campaigns used N=5000.
Deterministic signing mode tests (rnd=0) produce bit-exact reproducible failures, whereas hedged mode introduces attempt variation.
